localChanges: When a ship or Carrier is lost at sea, the units aboard are lost with it, whether it sank in a storm, was disbanded, or was lost because its home city was captured or could no longer support it. Before, they were left stranded at sea, still aboard a ship that no longer existed (closes #104).
When a ship or Carrier is lost in one of your cities, the units aboard now stay in the city and can be moved again.
